companyFieldUpdates.name: Anza Renewables
companyFieldUpdates.description: Anza Renewables is the operating brand of Anza RE, LLC, a U.S. software-enabled procurement, data and analytics platform serving solar and battery-storage developers, independent power producers and other energy buyers. Its tools support module, inverter, storage and transformer sourcing, supplier evaluation and purchase-order execution. The business formally launched from Borrego in September 2022. Borrego contracted to sell all Anza RE, LLC equity to Anza RE Buyer, LLC on February 24, 2023 for US$26.74 million, and Anza announced the completed separation on May 17, 2023 with investment from ECP's Energy Transition Opportunities Fund, Angeleno Group and other investors. ECP and Angeleno continue to list Anza as active; exact stakes, control, the full cap table and the legal closing day are not publicly disclosed. The company is headquartered in Oakland, California and reports more than 80 subscribers and support for over 8 GW of PV and 5 GWh of BESS purchase orders. No later sale or signed pending exit was identified through August 19, 2026.
